title: ربط الادعاء بالأثر الفعلي
rule:
Applies when: When validating evidence.
Bind results to a nonempty target set and actual artifact/candidate identity; reject missing or altered evidence and distinguish integrity from authenticity.
rationale: دليل فارغ أو محرف قد يتحول إلى إثبات زائف. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
